text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way back from an outing with
Meisho
Doto, when she suddenly stops...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh... it's a soft-serve parlor...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Eep! Not at all! S-sorry it looked like
that! I was
just a little curious...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Groooowl...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Nooo! This isn't what you think it is! I
had a lot of
fun today, so naturally my
stomach has gotten
empty and...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Let's grab some for the road.

text_block_list.text:
We sh-shouldn't! I'll probably spill it or
drop it
completely...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: That won't happen if we take our time.

text_block_list.text:
Finding a seat on a park bench, I savor
some
soft-serve ice cream with Meisho
Doto.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Mmm... This ice cream is delicious—cold,
with the
gentle taste of milk...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I probably would have walked on by if
you hadn't
said something, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Oh, um... You see...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Soft-serve ice cream has always been a
favorite
of mine. As a child, I used to
beg my parents for
some whenever we
went out together.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
But it wouldn't last very long. I would
accidentally
drop it, or a goat would
snatch it straight from my
hands.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
My parents never got upset. But I felt so
bad
about it, I gradually stopped
asking...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
But with your help, I'm eating what is my
first ice
cream in a long time.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
You're always giving me the opportunity
to pick
up the things I nearly gave up
on...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
So much so, I'm even starting to believe
I'm
capable of doing more. Ridiculous,
right?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: What kind of things do you want to try out?

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well... There are quite a lot of
other things
I've thought about eating...
or buying, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Want to come shopping with me?
Let's go on a little food tour!

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well... There are quite a lot of
other things
I've thought about eating...
or buying, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Want to come shopping with me?
Let's go on a little food tour!

text_block_list.text:
Oh... Shopping... together? With you?
Um... But...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Won't you get... irritated with me? What
if I get
tired halfway through the trip?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Tell me what you'd like to buy.

text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting to buy myself a coffee
mug,
actually. There's an adorable round
one I've been
eyeing, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm too scared to go on my own... I can
picture
myself accidentally breaking
their merchandise...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Really? But, what if my hands start to
shake from
the nerves, or... I'm not able
to walk straight
anymore?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: I'll be by your side, trust me.

text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Thank you so much. I'll see this
through, I
promise.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Oh... I can't really walk and eat at the
same time...
I'm sure to mess something
up.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Although... I do think it would be fun to
go with
you, Trainer. So... it won't hurt to
try, right?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Croquettes... those are crispy and
delicious,
aren't they? The warm, meaty
juices flood your
taste buds, but your
hands and clothes get all
oily... Oogh...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm not so good with takoyaki either...
I've burned
my mouth so many times...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I never know where to bite first... Is the
tail
better, or the head?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: All right, let's have all three!

text_block_list.text:
Aaagh! Wait, sh-should we really? It
sounds a
little overwhelming, but... Um!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
With Мэйсё Дото in rare high spirits, we
explore
the shopping district trying all
the foods that
pique our interest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm glad that she's relaxed a bit. We
manage to
wrap up our shopping detour
with no hiccups.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
